A critical exchange-rate endpoint marker clipped during strong appreciation. Actual plot margins were enlarged.

Literal Chromium/Node complete model equality rejected an8.88e-16 Math.log difference. The harness applies the already declared8e-12 log and3e-13 physical gates; exact intended state, sign/range, signed zero and same-browser Share readouts stay strict.
Strong small-open-economy appreciation put the selected marker outside a linear q domain. The plot now uses a positive explicitly labelled logarithmic q axis and native axis/marker assertions.
The first complete content test looked for scope wording in the wrong field. That brittle wording assertion was removed; frozen identity/source and complete-content assertions remain.

Final pixel review found missing spaces in sample text and source attributions. Copy and syllabus mirrors were corrected, all28native layouts/all88modes/all28rich layouts rerun, and changed pixels personally reviewed again.
One production dark invocation used an unsupported --theme=dark flag and actually repeated light. It is not dark evidence. Correct --dark runs passed before and after the final copy repair.
